limitations: The three seed cases were convenience-selected during API feasibility work and are not a holdout or prevalence sample.
REST v3 and GraphQL v4 are separate representations backed by GitHub, not independent ground-truth providers; agreement detects capture and normalization mistakes but not correlated upstream errors.
The GraphQL observation reproduces the Inbox fields and reviewer filter, but it is not an authenticated-viewer CLI run because the public reviewers are not the capture account.
The captures are sequential rather than atomic; the bounded capture span and per-asset timestamps expose but cannot eliminate concurrent pull-request changes.
The oracle checks metadata classification only; it does not measure Resume correctness, time saved, issue recall, safety, retention, or willingness to pay.
This seed has no missing-OID or multi-page reviewer-history case; controlled transport tests cover those paths until a prospective real case is frozen.
Public reviewer logins and immutable user IDs are retained solely to exercise the reviewer identity boundary.
